best_secondary_ranked.effect: +50% Action Skill Cooldown Rate for 8s on use
best_secondary_ranked.why: Clears the leftover 25% Peacebreaker CD after a 3-charge Caffeine dump — highest AS uptime secondary.
Directly feeds Waterfall hop damage and splash-crit El Paraguas.
Buffs Maliwan PlasmaCoil / Kickballer elements and Peacebreaker snapshot damage.
More Waterfall / Firepot throws in the grenade loop.
Bossing secondary winner: +200% next shot × 3 Triple Bypass charges for phase burst. Mobbing/balanced still prefer Accelerator for leftover CD clear.

best_secondary_ranked.why: Helps gun DPS under Overdrive; small kit-CD penalty.
Faster charge regen between dumps; take if Accelerator already secured via other means.

ideal_triple_bypass.size: Mini preferred (shorter kit CD) unless you need Mega heal for UVH survival
ideal_triple_bypass.firmware: LVL25+ can roll firmware — favor Gadget Ahoy / Airstrike if available on kit

purple_bridge.why_purple: Order manufacturer trait = 2 charges on Epic. Epic rolls Primary + Secondary (e.g. Accelerator + Splash Damage). Legendary Triple Bypass locks the legendary perk slot to 3-charge/Heart Pump and only allows ONE secondary — so a purple Order with Accelerator + Splash/Elemental Affinity has two combat buffs you cannot stack the same way on a legendary. Use until Triple Bypass drops, or keep if your Triple Bypass secondary is trash.
purple_bridge.farm: World Drop (Repair Kits) and Order-weighted pools; farm bosses that drop Order gear / general legendary/epic kits
